 def mean(values):

+def median(values):
+    ordered = sorted(values)
+    middle = len(ordered) // 2
+    if len(ordered) % 2:
+        return ordered[middle]
+    return (ordered[middle - 1] + ordered[middle]) / 2
problem_statement: Add a median(numbers) function to calc.py: the middle value for an odd-length list, the mean of the two middle values for an even-length list. The existing mean() function already works and must keep working.
